implementation: Independent paper-and-appendix-based NS adaptation; not an exact author implementation or benchmark reproduction.
shared_execution: Existing NS literature host, canonical command Agent, private validation, hard-wall accounting and phase-boundary continuation.
public_source_status: Author-linked repository returned HTTP 404 through the GitHub API on the audit date; no upstream commit is claimed.
preserved: Sequential classification, analytic treatment, transformation, decomposition and stability analyses
Independent Genesis programs form a complete unranked candidate pool
Each judge sees the entire pool, selects its top half and nominates one program for outer evaluation
Judges receive common completed-round numerical feedback and improve or combine nominated programs
A later cycle expands the pool and resets judge histories
bounded_v1_adaptations: Three initial Genesis programs instead of the paper default thirty-two; three judges, one cycle and one hybrid round in the small-budget template
Common model and at most twelve Agent hours including analysis and selection calls; at most two hours per Genesis or judge branch
Incremental changes are delivered as full standard NS bundles with a requested diff description, rather than the native patch format
Common NS validation reports replace author task-specific execution feedback; no pre-ranking all Genesis programs by validation
Optional S0 is validated as a delivery fallback, not added as a Genesis seed
Fixed sampled versus continuous-online Base is our paired environment intervention
Use one common model for all judges instead of the paper default heterogeneous o3, DeepSeek-R1 and GPT-4o mixture; keeps the environment pair controlled.

completion_v2.common_environment: same frozen 64 v6 Cases, finite references in both arms; online continuous public inputs and unlimited Base; no continuous truth
